method: CPU diagnostic only, not WGSL execution/readback, final pixel contrast, photographic acceptance or GPU performance. Exactly one full256³/128³ volume; existing16³ half-float clamp/trilinear flow reference. Material position is filtered once; flow.a and existing camera micro erosion are included in density. Five fixed front UV rays, approach.8/.95/1, cloud time60, wind.55, mature growth, no gust/dispersion/rain/flash, clear daytime left sun. Camera target and near radius are fixed; no live surface probe. Midpoint quadrature3/6m with exponential opacity weights T_before*(1-exp(-sigma*ds)), cutoff.006 and clipped final segments. Optical depths sampled at unwarped filtered local coordinates, retaining the co-deformed static-light approximation. Candidate changes only ambient: baseline exp(-.35*tauVertical), candidate skyVisibility(vertical,lateral,massFactor); direct and multiple are shared exactly. ambientSkyResponse includes the existing.35 softening; physicalAperture uses exp(-tau) without softening and the same positive directional weights. Source moments are luminance before aerial mixing and tone mapping; across-five-ray CV is of per-ray opacity-weighted means, not an image metric.
